name: spaceghost
title: spaceghost
blurb: you are tonight's guest on space ghost coast to coast, seated pov in the guest chair on a real 3d webgl set: the console in front of you, zorak caged to one side, moltar's screen flickering on the other, the ghost planet outside the window. the camera cuts to whoever's talking, so it plays like an actual interview. answer the questions; he will not listen; the control room may catch fire. leave with an episode title, a ghostly rating, and a card to share. asked for by ver.ooo.
